tasks.title: Project Setup and Configuration
tasks.description: Initialize the project repository with Next.js frontend and Node.js/Express backend, configure TypeScript, and set up the development environment.
tasks.details:
1. Create a monorepo structure with separate directories for frontend and backend
2. Initialize Next.js frontend with TypeScript:
   ```bash
   npx create-next-app@latest frontend --typescript
   ```
3. Initialize Node.js/Express backend with TypeScript:
   ```bash
   mkdir backend
   cd backend
   npm init -y
   npm install express typescript ts-node @types/node @types/express
   npx tsc --init
   ```
4. Configure tsconfig.json for both frontend and backend
5. Set up ESLint and Prettier for code quality
6. Create basic folder structure for both projects
7. Configure environment variables (.env files)
8. Set up Git repository with .gitignore
9. Create README.md with setup instructions
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify that both frontend and backend projects compile without errors
2. Ensure all dependencies are correctly installed
3. Confirm that development servers can be started
4. Validate TypeScript configuration
5. Test environment variable loading

tasks.title: Database Schema Design and Prisma Setup
tasks.description: Set up PostgreSQL database, configure Prisma ORM, and implement the data models as defined in the PRD.
tasks.details:
1. Install PostgreSQL locally or set up a cloud instance
2. Install Prisma in the backend project:
   ```bash
   npm install prisma @prisma/client
   npx prisma init
   ```
3. Configure the database connection in .env
4. Implement the data models in schema.prisma as specified in the PRD:
   - User model with roles
   - Listing model with asset types
   - FinancingTerms model
   - BuyerProfile model
   - Dealroom model
   - Message model
   - Document model for NDAs and confidential files
   - Activity log model for dealroom interactions
5. Create initial migrations:
   ```bash
   npx prisma migrate dev --name init
   ```
6. Generate Prisma client:
   ```bash
   npx prisma generate
   ```
7. Create a database service layer for interacting with the models
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify database connection
2. Test migrations run successfully
3. Validate schema against PRD requirements
4. Create test data and verify CRUD operations
5. Test relationships between models
6. Ensure proper indexing for performance

tasks.title: Term Sheet Builder with Seller Financing
tasks.description: Implement a term sheet builder that allows sellers to create and buyers to view financing term sheets with interactive amortization previews, including interest rate, duration, down payment, and payment calculations.
tasks.details:
1. Create TermSheet model extending the FinancingTerms model:
   ```typescript
   interface TermSheet extends FinancingTerms {
     id: string;
     listingId: string;
     title: string;
     description?: string;
     isDefault: boolean;
     createdAt: Date;
     updatedAt: Date;
   }
   ```

2. Update Prisma schema to include TermSheet model with appropriate relations to Listing model.

3. Implement term sheet controller with CRUD endpoints:
   - POST /api/listings/:id/term-sheets
   - GET /api/listings/:id/term-sheets
   - GET /api/listings/:id/term-sheets/:sheetId
   - PUT /api/listings/:id/term-sheets/:sheetId
   - DELETE /api/listings/:id/term-sheets/:sheetId

4. Create amortization calculation service:
   ```typescript
   class AmortizationService {
     calculateAmortizationSchedule(principal: number, interestRate: number, termMonths: number, downPayment: number): AmortizationSchedule;
     calculateMonthlyPayment(principal: number, interestRate: number, termMonths: number): number;
     calculateTotalInterest(schedule: AmortizationSchedule): number;
   }
   ```

5. Implement term sheet builder component in React:
   - Form inputs for interest rate, duration, down payment
   - Real-time validation with appropriate constraints
   - Preview of monthly payment calculation
   - Amortization schedule visualization
   - Save/update functionality

6. Create interactive amortization preview component:
   - Monthly payment breakdown
   - Principal vs. interest visualization
   - Payment schedule table with sorting/filtering
   - Export to PDF/CSV functionality

7. Implement seller term sheet management UI:
   - Create multiple term sheet options
   - Set default term sheet
   - Compare different financing scenarios
   - Duplicate and modify existing term sheets

8. Create buyer-facing term sheet viewer:
   - Read-only view of term sheet details
   - Interactive amortization calculator for "what-if" scenarios
   - Highlight key terms and conditions
   - Interest saved compared to standard rates

9. Implement caching for expensive amortization calculations to improve performance.

1. Unit test the AmortizationService:
   - Verify payment calculation accuracy with known examples
   - Test edge cases (zero down payment, short/long terms)
   - Validate amortization schedule generation

2. Test term sheet CRUD operations:
   - Create term sheets with various parameters

3. Integration test the term sheet builder UI:

```typescript
interface DocumentTemplate {
  id: string;
  type: 'NDA' | 'LOI' | 'TERM_SHEET';
  name: string;
  content: string; // HTML/markdown with variable placeholders
  variables: string[]; // List of variable names used in template

  createdAt: Date;
  updatedAt: Date;
}
```

3. Create document generation service:
```typescript
class DocumentGenerationService {
  async generateDocument(templateId: string, data: Record<string, any>): Promise<string>;
  async createPDF(htmlContent: string): Promise<Buffer>;
  async storeGeneratedDocument(documentType: string, listingId: string, content: Buffer): Promise<string>;
}
```

4. Implement e-signing integration:

5. Create document endpoints:

   - POST /api/templates (create new template - admin only)
   - PUT /api/templates/:id (update template - admin only)
   - POST /api/documents/generate (generate document from template)
   - POST /api/documents/:id/sign (initiate signing process)
   - GET /api/documents/:id/status (check signing status)

6. Implement document versioning:

   - Store all versions of generated documents
   - Provide access to document history

3. Create stories for all component variants with usage examples
4. Add documentation for animation patterns with interactive examples
5. Include accessibility guidelines and best practices
6. Document responsive behavior with viewport tools, showcasing mobile-first patterns from subtask 35.4 including touch-friendly interaction zones, responsive navigation drawer, and breakpoint-specific component layouts
7. Create component composition examples for common patterns, including mobile-responsive layouts with stacked vs side-by-side variants and examples of responsive spacing and grid configurations
8. Add search and navigation to improve documentation usability
subtasks.testStrategy: Verify documentation accuracy against implemented components. Test Storybook performance with all components. Conduct user testing with developers to ensure documentation clarity and usefulness.

tasks.title: Pro Seller Subscription - Extended Implementation Spec
tasks.description: Extend the Pro Seller Subscription implementation with comprehensive security measures, error handling, webhook processing, subscription management flows, and API contracts to ensure a robust and secure billing system.

subtasks.title: Implement Zod Schema Validation for Subscription Inputs
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive Zod schemas for all subscription-related inputs to ensure data validation before processing.
subtasks.details: Create a validation.ts file in the lib/subscription directory with Zod schemas for: subscription creation, cancellation, upgrade/downgrade, payment method updates, and coupon application. Include custom error messages for each validation failure case. Implement a validateRequest middleware that uses these schemas to validate incoming requests before they reach the controllers.
subtasks.testStrategy: Write unit tests for each schema to verify validation works correctly with valid and invalid inputs. Test edge cases like empty strings, invalid UUIDs, and missing required fields.

subtasks.title: Develop Stripe API Error Handling Service with Exponential Backoff
subtasks.description: Create a robust error handling service for Stripe API calls that implements exponential backoff for transient errors.
subtasks.details: Create a stripe-service.ts file that implements the callStripeWithRetry function with configurable retry attempts and backoff strategy. Add specific error categorization for Stripe errors (network, authentication, rate limiting, etc.). Implement proper logging for retry attempts and failures. Ensure idempotency keys are used for all Stripe API calls that support them, following the format `sub_${userId}_${action}_${timestamp}`.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests with mocked Stripe responses to simulate different error scenarios. Test the backoff algorithm to ensure it correctly implements exponential delays. Verify idempotency key generation is consistent.

subtasks.title: Create User-Facing Error Message System
subtasks.description: Implement a comprehensive error message mapping system that translates technical errors into user-friendly messages.
subtasks.details: Create an errors.ts file with a mapping of error codes to user-friendly messages for all possible Stripe and application errors. Implement a function that takes a technical error and returns an appropriate user message and HTTP status code. Add support for localization of error messages. Create a consistent error response format for all API endpoints.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test error translation for all defined error types. Verify HTTP status codes are appropriate for each error scenario. Test with different locales if localization is implemented.

subtasks.title: Implement Stripe Webhook Processing System
subtasks.description: Create a secure and robust system for processing Stripe webhooks with signature verification and idempotent event handling.
subtasks.details: Extend the webhook-handler.ts to verify Stripe signatures for all incoming webhook requests. Create a StripeEvent table in the database for tracking processed events. Implement handlers for all required webhook events (checkout.session.completed, customer.subscription.created, etc.). Add structured logging for webhook processing. Ensure idempotent processing by checking if an event has already been processed before handling it.
subtasks.testStrategy: Create tests with mock webhook payloads for each event type. Test signature verification with valid and invalid signatures. Verify idempotent processing by sending duplicate events.

subtasks.title: Develop Subscription Cancellation and Refund System
subtasks.description: Implement the logic for handling subscription cancellations with immediate or end-of-period options and refund processing.
subtasks.details: Create a cancellation-service.ts file that implements immediate and end-of-period cancellation options. Add refund eligibility checking based on the 7-day window. Implement the database updates needed when a subscription is cancelled. Create an admin interface for manual refund processing with proper authorization checks. Add audit logging for all cancellation and refund actions.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test both cancellation types (immediate and end-of-period) with the Stripe API in test mode. Verify refund eligibility logic works correctly for subscriptions of different ages. Test admin refund processing with different user roles.

subtasks.title: Implement Subscription Upgrade and Downgrade Logic
subtasks.description: Create the system for handling subscription plan changes with appropriate proration rules.
subtasks.details: Create a plan-change-service.ts file that implements immediate upgrades with proration and scheduled downgrades for the next billing cycle. Add proration calculation functions that estimate the cost of plan changes. Implement the database updates needed when a subscription plan changes. Add support for special handling of 14-day trials for first-time Starter subscribers. Create clear user notifications about proration and effective dates.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test upgrade and downgrade flows with the Stripe API in test mode. Verify proration calculations match Stripe's calculations. Test the special trial handling for new subscribers. Verify database state after plan changes.

subtasks.title: Implement Trial Period and Subscription Status Management
subtasks.description: Develop the system for managing trial periods, subscription status transitions, and related user permissions.
subtasks.details: Create a subscription-status-service.ts file that tracks and updates subscription statuses based on webhook events and user actions. Implement the 14-day trial logic for first-time subscribers. Add functions to check if a user has active subscription permissions. Create a system for handling grace periods after failed payments. Implement subscription resumption logic for recently cancelled subscriptions.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test trial period start and end with the Stripe API. Verify permission checks work correctly for different subscription statuses. Test grace period behavior after simulated payment failures. Verify subscription resumption works within the allowed timeframe.

subtasks.title: Develop Admin Subscription Management API
subtasks.description: Create secure API endpoints for administrative management of user subscriptions with proper authorization.
subtasks.details: Create admin-subscription-controller.ts with endpoints for viewing all subscriptions, manually updating subscription status, processing refunds, extending subscriptions, and overriding normal limitations. Implement strict authorization checks that only allow admin users to access these endpoints. Add comprehensive audit logging for all admin actions. Create database queries optimized for filtering and paginating subscription data.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test all admin endpoints with different user roles to verify authorization. Test each administrative action to ensure it correctly updates the subscription in both the database and Stripe. Verify audit logs are created for all actions.

subtasks.title: Implement Security Hardening for Subscription System
subtasks.description: Add security measures including rate limiting, ownership verification, and proper authentication for all subscription-related endpoints.
subtasks.details: Create security middleware for rate limiting subscription-related actions (10 per hour per user). Implement the verifySubscriptionOwnership middleware to ensure users can only access their own subscriptions. Add CSRF protection for all state-changing endpoints. Ensure all endpoints require proper authentication. Implement structured logging with PII redaction. Configure proper CORS settings for subscription endpoints.
subtasks.testStrategy: Test rate limiting by making rapid requests and verifying the rate limit is enforced. Test subscription ownership verification with attempts to access other users' data. Verify authentication requirements for all endpoints. Test CSRF protection with simulated attacks.

subtasks.title: Create Comprehensive Test Suite for Subscription System
subtasks.description: Develop a complete test suite covering unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for the subscription system.
subtasks.details: Create unit tests for all validation schemas, utility functions, and isolated business logic. Develop integration tests that verify the interaction between components and with the database. Implement end-to-end tests that simulate complete user flows from subscription creation to cancellation. Create test fixtures and mocks for Stripe API responses. Add performance tests for webhook processing under load. Implement security-focused tests that attempt to bypass validations and access controls.
subtasks.testStrategy: Run the test suite in CI/CD pipeline before deployment. Use Stripe test mode for integration and E2E tests. Create a test database with realistic data volumes. Measure code coverage and aim for at least 80% coverage of all subscription-related code.
